$comment: fix.scopeFence: deterministic repair push fence. Defaults enabled=true, mode=stand-down; warn posts a note and permits the push. Cascade standard -> platform fix.scopeFence -> tool -> WE_FIX_SCOPE_FENCE_ENABLED / WE_FIX_SCOPE_FENCE_MODE. Sources are logged at push time. Out-of-scope work requires an operator scope-increase request. scope-removed: identifier, functionName in an operator send-back or removal commit prevents reintroduction.
